description: Rename a project and/or change its linked GitHub repo URL — the MCP self-service counterpart to the dashboard project settings. Owner-only. The project slug never changes on a rename. Omit a field to leave it untouched; pass repo_url="" to unlink the repo. Use when the user asks to rename a project or link a repo instead of telling them to open the dashboard. Destructive operations (delete project, reset connection) stay dashboard-gated. No Anthropic API.

name.description: New display name (max 100 characters). The slug is never changed by a rename.

project.description: Project id or slug to edit. Omit to edit the project this connection is bound to.

repo_url.description: GitHub repository URL (https://github.com/owner/repo). Pass an empty string to unlink the repo.

name: project_edit
